description: Off-white canvas. Grey rounded box upper-centre with serif text "Q. What would happen if you were to gather a mole (unit of measurement) of moles (the small furry critter) in one place?" and attribution "- Sean Rice". Black-ink stick figure at left holding a sheet of paper; empty whiteboard outline right. Frames 0-69 (encoder artifacts early).
Handwritten-style label "MOLE =" appears upper-left inside the whiteboard in one sampled frame; question box and figure unchanged.
Whiteboard shows only "MOLE =" upper-left; figure and question box unchanged.
Two-line label "# OF ATOMS IN 12g OF CARBON-12" appears to the right of "MOLE =" in one frame.
Board: "MOLE = # OF ATOMS IN 12g OF CARBON-12". Figure and question box unchanged.
Small "X" appears below "MOLE" at left of the board (one frame).
Board: "MOLE = # OF ATOMS IN 12g OF CARBON-12" with "X" below it.
Second line "MOLE =" appears below the "X" (one frame).
Board: three lines - "MOLE = # OF ATOMS IN 12g OF CARBON-12", "X", "MOLE =".
Small black line drawing of a mole (the animal) appears right of the second "MOLE =" (one frame).
Board: "MOLE = # OF ATOMS IN 12g OF CARBON-12", "X", "MOLE = [small mole drawing]". Held about 3.4 s.

One frame: a tilted black bar with white hand-lettered "CENSORED" covers the board contents; stick figure now has an "!" above its head and an arm swung toward the board (pose changed from reading paper). Question box still present top.
Black "CENSORED" bar over the board; startled stick figure with "!" at left; question box top.

49-frame interval. At 12.04 s hard cut to flat red full-frame title card: black silhouette of a creature on a satellite-like object upper-centre, white text "xkcd's what if? THE VIDEO SERIES". Sampled frames show it essentially static with small horizontal text/graphic offset between tiles (UNRESOLVED whether a slow drift or tile artefact). Final frame (14.04 s) is a new scene: white canvas, stick figure at left, whiteboard titled "A MOLE:", empty. Exact cut-out frame of the title card UNRESOLVED.
White canvas; stick figure at left with arm raised toward board; board headed "A MOLE:" otherwise empty. Question box gone.
Handwritten facts written on in order: "3" then "3kg" upper-left, "71°C" centre, "4km" lower-left of the board (about 9 frames).
Board "A MOLE:" with scattered black items "3kg", "71°C", "4km".
Red diagonal scribble lines drawn across "3kg", "71°C", "4km" progressively (stroke by stroke, red ink) over about 10 frames.
Three items now covered by dense red hatch/scribble.
Black handwritten words written on letter by letter right of the scribble: "DOZEN", "HUNDRED", "GROSS", "BILLION" (staggered diagonally). Scribble persists.
Board: "A MOLE:" with red-scribbled struck items at left and "DOZEN", "HUNDRED", "GROSS", "BILLION" at right.
All board content except "A MOLE:" disappears in one frame (including red scribble).
Board with only "A MOLE:" heading; figure at left.
Digits begin to be handwritten left of board middle: "6", "60", "602," (about 21 frames).
Board: "602," written left-middle.
Number continues letter by letter: "602,2", "602,214," (17 frames). Written on at roughly one glyph per 3-4 frames.
Number continues: "602,214,129," (16 frames).
Number extends quickly with zeros to "602,214,129,000,000,000,000,000" across the board (11 frames, faster than preceding digits).
Board: "A MOLE: 602,214,129,000,000,000,000,000" centred on one line.
Second line written below: "= 6.022 · 10" then superscript "23" (26 frames).
Board: long number and "= 6.022 · 10^23" below it.
One frame: a second stick figure wearing a dark hat appears at far left overlapping/adjacent to the original figure, which is shifted right and facing it; board unchanged.
Hat-wearing stick figure at left edge beside the original figure standing against the board. Board unchanged.
One frame: hat figure gone; remaining figure at left with one arm extended toward the number; red diagonal strike through the "9" digits ("129"); the "= 6.022 · 10^23" line is gone.
Board: "602,214,129,000,000,000,000,000" with red slash through "29"; figure pointing at board; second line removed. Held about 5.4 s.
Red handwritten digits written above the black number: "6", "60", "602", "602," (17 frames).
Red "602," above black number with red-slashed "129".
Red line continues "602,2", "602,214," (17 frames).
Red "602,214," above black line.
Red line "602,214,076,000,000,000,000,000" above black line "602,214,129,000,...,000" with red slash on 129. Figure pointing.
One frame: figure arm drops from pointing to a hand-raised pose at left of board.
Same two lines; figure standing with one arm raised.
Black horizontal subtraction line drawn under the lines left-to-right, then "- 53,000,000,000,000" typed on below (20 frames).
Subtraction layout: red number, black number, rule, and "- 53,000,000,000,000".
Line under begins: "-", "-0", "-0." (7 frames).
"-0." below the 53 trillion line.
Adds a digit: "-0.0" (4 frames).
Settled 3-frame hold: board subtraction result line reads '-0.0' under red/black 602,214,... rows and '- 53,000,000,000,000,000' (digit-by-digit write-on cadence ~4 f write / 3 f hold, G0048-G0056).
Adds a digit: "-0.00" (4 frames).
Adds a digit: "-0.000".
Adds a digit: "-0.0000".
Adds a digit: "-0.00000".
Completes "-0.000009%" over 10 frames.
Completed subtraction: "-53,000,000,000,000" and "-0.000009%". Held about 3.3 s.
One frame: figure's raised hand now holds a small drawn marker/chalk with dripping dotted line below its hand; arm lowered.
Figure at left holding small drawn object in hand with dotted drip lines; board unchanged.
Speech label "THERE ARE TOO MANY MOLECULES" appears above-left of the board with a curved leader line to the figure's head (one frame).
Board unchanged; speech label "THERE ARE TOO MANY MOLECULES" present.
Hard cut to white canvas: "1 MOLE" label upper-left, a small bottle marked "H2" on a digital scale, label "1 GRAM OF HYDROGEN" below.
"1 MOLE" over bottle on scale with "1 GRAM OF HYDROGEN". Held about 5 s.
Right side adds label "1 MOLE OF SAND GRAINS" and a grey-filled globe drawing of Earth (one frame).
Two-panel comparison: hydrogen scale at left, Earth globe at right with "1 MOLE OF SAND GRAINS".
Hard cut to four labelled drawings in a row: "SHREW MOLE", "COAST MOLE", "TOWNSEND'S MOLE" (line-drawn mole animals) and quoted "MOLE" over a squirrel-like animal with glasses.
Four labelled mole drawings; fourth is a squirrel/chipmunk with glasses labelled with quote marks.
Hard cut to a stick figure seated at a computer desk (left) with a tag "STAR-NOSED MOLE" above.
Seated figure at desk, label "STAR-NOSED MOLE" above, rest empty.
Small "SEARCH" box appears under the star-nosed mole tag (one frame).
Figure at desk with "STAR-NOSED MOLE" and "SEARCH" boxes.
Second desk/figure appears to the right of the first; figure recoils with sweat marks, large hand-lettered "BLEEAUGH!" above it. Whole row of figures shifted up compared with previous hold.
Two desks: left figure calmly searching, middle figure reacting with "BLEEAUGH!".

Three desk figures; "BLEEAUGH!" above middle.

"BLEEAUGH!" struck out in red with red "PRETTY" above.

Red "PRETTY GROSS" above red-struck "BLEEAUGH!"; three desk figures.
Hard cut to plain white canvas with the long number "602,214,076,000,000,000,000,000" in black centred.
Number alone in centre of white canvas.
Over 7 frames a dense grey-brown field of tiny mole drawings sweeps in from the left and then fills the canvas, leaving a white ragged halo around the number; text remains legible.
Whole frame filled with grey-brown mole-drawing pattern; number in a white cut-out halo at centre-upper. Held about 5 s.
Hard cut to white board scene: stick figure with hand to chin at left, empty whiteboard, small grey mole lying on the ground lower-right of figure.
Thinking figure at left, empty board, small mole on floor.
"1" then "10" written upper-left on board (9 frames).
Board: "10".
Adds "≈ 1" (8 frames).
Adds "≈ 0.1" (12 frames).

Figure holding the mole next to the board.

Figure with throwing pose; mole in flight inside board area.
Label "1lb" with curved arrow pointing to the flying mole appears (one frame).
Board: "10 ≈ 1 ≈ 0.1", flying mole with "1lb" arrow.
"1lb" extended to "1lb ≈ 1kg" over 6 frames.
Board with "1lb ≈ 1kg" label and flying mole.
Hard cut to white canvas: tiny caption "ONE MOLE" above the long number "602,214,076,000,000,000,000,000" at upper-centre.
Number with "ONE MOLE" caption only.
Double-headed dimension arrow drawn left to right below the number, with end ticks (6 frames).
Number with full-width dimension arrow below.

Grey short dimension arrow with "1,000,000,000,000 ONE TRILLION" fades in under the left part, then a second one fades in at the lower right (7 frames). Layout also shifts up on the canvas relative to tiles of the prior hold.
Number with "ONE MOLE" caption, full-width arrow, two shorter arrows labelled "1,000,000,000,000 ONE TRILLION" (left black, right grey).
Red words "OF MOLES" appended to caption "ONE MOLE" (one frame); right trillion label darkens slightly.
Caption "ONE MOLE OF MOLES" (red "OF MOLES").
Red "kg" appended after the right trillion; small mole drawing with "≈ 1kg" appears at upper-right (one frame).
Layout with red "kg" and small mole "≈ 1kg" icon.
Curly brace under both trillion labels with arrow to "≈" and a small ringed planet drawing (Saturn-like) appears (one frame).
Full diagram: number, arrows, two trillions, brace, "≈ [ringed planet]". Held about 4 s.
Hard cut back to the earlier whiteboard scene: figure at left (arm raised), board "10 ≈ 1 ≈ 0.1", mole in flight, "1lb ≈ 1kg" (callback to G0103 state; figure pose differs).
Whiteboard with figure, "10 ≈ 1 ≈ 0.1", "1lb ≈ 1kg".
Label "*/÷ 1000" with leader to the figure's head appears upper-left (one frame).
Whiteboard with "*/÷ 1000" label above the figure.
Board contents replaced in one frame by a drawn mound labelled "MOLE OF MOLES" "≈" a cratered moon labelled "MOON"; figure and board frame unchanged, "*/÷ 1000" label gone.
Board: "MOLE OF MOLES ≈ MOON" with pile and moon drawings. Held about 4.6 s.
One frame: board is emptied; figure now leans forward at the board holding a marker (new pose).
Empty board; figure leaning toward it.
Grey small mole drawing with "75g", arrow, and "MOLE" appear at the board's upper-left (one frame).
"75g" mole icon with arrow to "MOLE".
"6.022 · 10^23" (grey) and "MOLE · MOLE" appear (one frame).
Board: 75g mole icon, "6.022·10^23", "MOLE · MOLE".
"≈ 4.52·10^22 kg" appended (one frame).
Equation "MOLE · MOLE ≈ 4.52·10^22 kg".
"≳ 1/2" and a small moon icon appended (one frame).
Equation ends "≳ 1/2 [moon icon]".
Small mole drawing "≈" a small cup/glass drawing appears lower-left of the equation (one frame).
Added mole ≈ glass icon.
"1kg ≈ 1l" appears under the mole-glass icon (one frame).
Board with "1kg ≈ 1l" under icons. Held about 4.9 s.
"≈ 4.52·10^22 LITERS" with red underline appears right-centre (one frame).
Board with liters line underlined in red.

Hard cut to white canvas with horizon line: an airplane (upper-left) spilling a big grey-brown stream of matter diagonally down-right; two stick figures at lower-left; speech label "HOW DID THOSE EVEN FIT ON THAT PLANE?".
Plane, brown mole stream, two figures with speech label.

Hard cut to Earth cross-section diagram: black crust band with hatched "MANTLE" below, "CRUST" label, "AIR" with "Mt. EVEREST" marker, dashed line, "SPACE", "ISS", and a small brown mole mound at right.
Diagram with small brown mound at right of crust.
Brown mole layer now spans the whole crust, burying Mt. Everest; new labels "MOLES" and "DISPLACED AIR"; the dashed line and "SPACE"/"ISS" labels shift upward (one frame).
Diagram: brown "MOLES" layer on crust under "DISPLACED AIR", "SPACE", "ISS".
Hard cut to close view: black ground, huge brown-grey cliff of moles filling the top right, two small stick figures at lower-left standing in a pale triangular light wedge.
Cliff of moles with two figures at its base.

Figure and "MY OBSERVATIONS" list card.

Rocket, brown mass, figure and speech label on black background.

Figure with "GROSS." beside the labelled cutaway disc.
